name: Consignment vendor bypasses PO match
description: Invoices from consignment-type vendors carry no PO. The expert reconciles quantities and amounts against the monthly Consignment Statement tab, then approves.

name: Line-stoppage urgent payment, single approval
description: A CFO email tagged 'URGENT – line stoppage' for a critical vendor under ₹2,00,000 is released with one approver and a post-facto Finance Controller note.

name: Renumbered duplicate rejected
description: A resend with a new invoice number but the same vendor, amount and line items within 10 days is rejected as a duplicate.
